title: Avoiding Sanitary Tees on Horizontal Drain Runs
description: Installing a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe connection is a frequent installation error. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning from horizontal to vertical flow. When placed horizontally, they lack the gentle sweep required to direct wastewater smoothly, leading to solids accumulating and causing frequent clogs. Professional plumbing standards require using a combination wye and eighth bend or a long-sweep wye for horizontal drain changes. Always check local plumbing codes to select the correct directional fitting for horizontal waste lines.

Avoiding Sanitary Tees on Horizontal Drain Runs

Installing a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe connection is a frequent installation error. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning from horizontal to vertical flow. When placed horizontally, they lack the gentle sweep required to direct wastewater smoothly, leading to solids accumulating and causing frequent clogs. Professional plumbing standards require using a combination wye and eighth bend or a long-sweep wye for horizontal drain changes. Always check local plumbing codes to select the correct directional fitting for horizontal waste lines.
